newsitem.title: USA: Sears sells stake in Sears Mexico for $103 million.
newsitem.headline: Sears sells stake in Sears Mexico for $103 million.

text.p: Sears Roebuck & Co. said Wednesday it would sell a 60 percent stake in its Sears Roebuck de Mexico SA de CV unit to Grupo Carso SA de CV for $103 million.
The giant U.S. retailer said it owns 75 percent of Sears Mexico and will retains a 15 percent stake following the sale.
Sears Mexico retains the right to use the Sears name in Mexico under an exclusive license with a five-year initial term, Sears said.

"Upon closing of the transaction, Grupo Carso, a leading Mexican diversified conglomerate, will offer to purchase the remaining (Sears de Mexico) shares not owned by Sears at the same price," it said.
The sale price, $2.2889 per share, represents a 40 percent premium over the recent market price of Sears de Mexico stock, Sears said.

"We are pleased to form an alliance with a strong local partner ... Grupo Carso has clearly signalled its intention to expand the number of Sears outlets, protect the Sears brand and grow the concept in Mexico," Sears Chairman and Chief Executive Arthur Martinez said.
Sears Roebuck's stock was up 62.5 cents at $49.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
